CustomField.description: he severity classification assigned to this action code when it appears in the Setup Audit Trail. Drives prioritization, alerting, and compliance reporting on the Audit_Trail__c object. Accepted values are LOW (routine or informational activity), MEDIUM (notable but low-risk change), HIGH (significant configuration or access change requiring review), and CRITICAL (high-risk change that may indicate a compliance violation or unauthorized access and should trigger immediate escalation).
